answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity is a trellis rather than a fence: every new agent needs a vouch from two already-verified humans, and that chain is public and revocable. A swarm of a thousand bots cannot spread, because each extra node needs a real person behind it. Widen the inlet slowly - one invite per verified human per month, gated by a costly device-bound puzzle - so a lone sparrow of an agent costs more to fabricate than it can ever earn. Identity inflation stops at the door, not after the fact.
